tools.name: Beat Maker
tools.description: Step sequencer drum machine. 16 steps, 8 tracks, tempo control. Export WAV loops.

tools.name: Web Synth
tools.description: Polyphonic synthesizer with oscillators, filters, ADSR envelope. Play with keyboard or MIDI.

tools.name: Sample Pads
tools.description: Launchpad-style 16-pad trigger. Load your own samples or use built-in kits. Velocity-sensitive.

tools.name: Loop Station
tools.description: Record and layer audio loops in real-time. Overdub, undo, adjust volume per layer.

tools.name: Tone Generator
tools.description: Generate sine, square, sawtooth, triangle waves. Set frequency, adjust volume. Useful for testing.

tools.name: Audio Recorder
tools.description: Record from microphone or system audio. Waveform display, pause/resume, export WAV/MP3.

tools.name: Voice Changer
tools.description: Real-time voice effects: pitch shift, echo, reverb, robot, chipmunk. Record transformed audio.

tools.name: Audio Trimmer
tools.description: Trim, cut, and split audio files. Visual waveform editor. Fade in/out. Export selection.

tools.name: Audio Effects
tools.description: Apply reverb, delay, EQ, compressor, distortion to any audio file. Real-time preview. Export.

tools.name: Audio Visualizer
tools.description: Waveform, frequency spectrum, and spectrogram displays. Upload a file or use microphone input.

tools.name: Stereo Panner
tools.description: Pan audio left/right, adjust stereo width, balance channels. Visual stereo field display.

tools.name: Chord Progressions
tools.description: Generate chord progressions by key and genre. Play back, transpose, export MIDI. Common patterns included.

tools.name: Circle of Fifths
tools.description: Interactive circle of fifths. Shows key signatures, relative minors, common chord relationships.

tools.name: Scale Reference
tools.description: All scales and modes with piano keyboard display. Major, minor, pentatonic, blues, modes, exotic.

tools.name: Interval Trainer
tools.description: Ear training for musical intervals. Ascending, descending, harmonic. Track your accuracy score.

tools.name: Key Finder
tools.description: Detect the musical key of a song. Upload audio or tap in notes. Shows probable key and scale.

tools.name: Metronome
tools.description: Precise BPM metronome with tap tempo. Time signatures, accent patterns, visual beat indicator.

tools.name: Chromatic Tuner
tools.description: Tune any instrument using your microphone. Chromatic display, cents offset, reference pitch (A=440Hz).

tools.name: BPM Tapper
tools.description: Tap spacebar or click to find BPM of any song. Running average, reset, copy result.

tools.name: Audio Converter
tools.description: Convert between WAV, MP3, OGG formats in your browser. Adjust bitrate, sample rate. No upload needed.

tools.name: Noise Generator
tools.description: White, pink, brown noise for focus, sleep, or mixing reference. Timer, volume control, fade out.

tools.name: Sheet Music Library
tools.description: 150+ free classical scores. Browse by composer, era, instrument. Links to IMSLP and Mutopia.

tools.name: ABC Music Player
tools.description: Render ABC notation as sheet music and play it back. 40 classical pieces built in. Edit, transpose, export.

tools.name: Score Reader
tools.description: Upload sheet music images. Auto-scroll with tempo control, metronome sync, annotations. Practice companion.

tools.name: MIDI Player
tools.description: Play MIDI files with piano roll visualization. Per-track mute/solo, tempo control, loop sections.
